Chapter 05 / 11ARCHITECTURE

A handoff needs an explicit payload.

An agent invocation does not imply access to another agent’s conversation. Pass the relevant findings or accessible artifact references with the task.

When synthesis receives no findings

Synthesis says no research was provided after search and analysis completed. The missing step is including their outputs in the synthesis prompt or an explicitly accessible artifact. Sharing an API connection does not share context.

A useful payload

Include objective, constraints, findings, claim–source links, unresolved gaps, and the expected output format. Verify artifact access. Summaries should preserve evidence and uncertainty, not only conclusions.

Related topics

Practice

What input is missing? Who owns the next action? What evidence must survive? Explain the failure before choosing a component.
